subject: sci-dym
title: SCI.DYM.------PROJ.DY.
description: Diagram in MP(II)-8, second of two on book p490, paired with v2-p490-1. SCI-DYM (scientific dynamics) is crossed with PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics): the question is what scientific-dynamics produces when crossed with projectional-dynamics in the context of state-broadcast cultural politics where the broadcasting apparatus doesn't comprehend its own material. INFO-DY (information dynamics) and ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism) form the upper-right cluster with METH (methodology). AFI (affinity insight) branches from the main line down to the left; INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) branches from the AFI line, AFL (affinity alignment) and MT-INFO (multi-information) both branch from the INDIV-TD line, and PER-TR (perceived transformation) branches from the MT-INFO line. A vertical drops from the main line through PART (participation) to C-INFO (composite information), and CULT-INFO-B (culture information basis) branches from it at PART; the main line ends at PROJ-DY.
